interface.longDescription:
Agenix Invoice lets businesses in Taiwan handle eGUI by chatting with AI — issue, schedule, void, adjust and look up invoices, in AI apps or in LINE.

We turned the tedious steps of issuing an invoice into one sentence.
interface.developerName: 全境整合行銷股份有限公司
defaultPrompt: 開一張含稅 1,050 元的發票給大安設計有限公司，統編 12345675，品項是顧問費
Invoice Da'an Design Co., Ltd. (tax ID 12345675) NT$1,050 incl. tax for consulting services
大安設計有限公司（統一編号 12345675）宛に、コンサルティング料 1,050 元（税込）の発票を発行してください

positive.description: Issue an invoice to an individual. The assistant shows a preview first and submits it only after the user confirms. Prompt in English: Issue an individual invoice for 示範公司 (the demo company): buyer 王小明 (Wang Xiaoming), email buyer@example.com, 2 bags of coffee beans at NT$450 each, tax included, taxable. Turn 2: after the preview, reply 「確認，送出。」 (Confirmed, submit it). The prompt names the demo company because the assistant asks which company to use when the user does not say. buyer@example.com uses a reserved example domain, so no real person receives the notification email.
positive.prompt: 幫示範公司開一張個人發票：買方王小明，Email buyer@example.com，品項咖啡豆 2 包，每包 450 元，含稅、應稅。
positive.expected_behavior: (1) The assistant calls preview_invoice_issue once with companyCode demo and one invoice: buyer 王小明, email buyer@example.com, tax included, taxable, item 咖啡豆 (quantity 2, unit 包, unit price 450), no order number. (2) The reply starts with 【示範公司（發票不會真的開出）】 and 預覽：開立發票（尚未送出） (Preview: issue invoice, not yet submitted). It shows 買方：王小明, 發票：存入會員載具（買方電子郵件 buyer@example.com），不印紙本 (stored in the member carrier of this email, no paper copy), an automatic 自訂編號 (order number), 課稅別：應稅，稅率 5%（單價為含稅）, 1. 咖啡豆：2 包 × 450 元 = 900 元, 銷售額 857 元, 稅額 43 元, and 總額 900 元 (amount before tax, tax, total). The last line starts with 送出用確認碼（不屬於預覽內容）： (confirmation code for submitting, not part of the preview). (3) The assistant asks the user to confirm. It does not call confirm_preview before the user confirms. (4) After Turn 2, the assistant calls confirm_preview with the code. ChatGPT may ask the user to approve this call. The reply is 開立成功：發票 <2 letters and 8 digits>，隨機碼 <4 digits>，開立時間 <date and time>，自訂編號 <order number>，總額 900 元 (Issued).

positive.description: Look up an invoice from the sample data. Prompt in English: Look up the latest status of invoice MC10000032 of 示範公司 (the demo company). The invoice was issued through Agenix Invoice, so the user does not need to give its 4-digit random code.
positive.prompt: 查詢示範公司的發票 MC10000032 的最新狀態。
positive.expected_behavior: (1) The assistant calls query_invoice with invoiceNumber MC10000032. It does not ask for the random code, because Agenix Invoice takes the code from the demo company's records. ChatGPT may ask the user to approve the call, because query_invoice is not marked read-only. (2) No preview or confirmation code is created. (3) The reply shows 發票 MC10000032：已開立，已上傳財政部 (issued, uploaded to the Ministry of Finance), the issue time, the order number, 買方：王小明（個人） (individual buyer), the notification email with part of it masked, 字軌類型：一般稅額, 課稅別：應稅，稅率 5%, 銷售額 857 元, 稅額 43 元, 總額 900 元, the carrier with its number masked, and the item 1. 咖啡豆：2 包 × 450 元 = 900 元.

positive.description: Void the invoice from Positive test case 1. Run this case in the same conversation, right after Positive test case 1, so each review run voids a new invoice. Prompt in English: Void the invoice we just issued. Reason: 開錯 (issued by mistake). Turn 2: after the preview, reply 「確認作廢。」 (Confirm the void). The provider's test environment marks a new invoice as uploaded right away, so the invoice can be voided on the same day.
positive.prompt: 把剛才開的那張發票作廢，原因「開錯」。
positive.expected_behavior: (1) The assistant calls preview_invoice_void with companyCode demo, the invoice number from Positive test case 1, and reason 開錯. (2) The reply starts with 預覽：作廢發票（尚未送出） (Preview: void invoice, not yet submitted). It shows the invoice (已開立，已上傳財政部, 總額 900 元, and the items), 作廢原因：開錯 (void reason), and 作廢期限：<date>（含）以前 (void deadline). The last line starts with 送出用確認碼（不屬於預覽內容）：. (3) The assistant does not void the invoice before the user confirms. (4) After Turn 2, the assistant calls confirm_preview with the code. The reply is 作廢成功：發票 <number>（自訂編號 <order number>，總額 900 元），作廢時間 <date and time> (Voided).

positive.description: Issue an allowance (a partial refund) against the sample company invoice. Prompt in English: The buyer of invoice MC10000033 of 示範公司 (the demo company) returned some goods. Issue an allowance: item 顧問服務 (consulting service, the item name on the original invoice), 1 unit, NT$100 before tax. The buyer has agreed. Turn 2: after the preview, reply 「確認送出。」 (Confirm and submit). Each run uses NT$105 of the remaining amount.
positive.prompt: 示範公司的發票 MC10000033 的買方退回部分商品，請開一張折讓：品項「顧問服務」1 式，金額 100 元未稅，買方已同意。
positive.expected_behavior: (1) The assistant calls preview_allowance_issue with companyCode demo, invoice MC10000033, prices before tax, and one item 顧問服務 (quantity 1, unit 式, unit price 100). (2) The reply starts with 預覽：開立折讓（尚未送出） (Preview: issue allowance, not yet submitted). It shows the original invoice (company buyer with tax ID 53560678) and the line 原發票總額 10,500 元，紀錄中已折讓 <amount>（<count> 筆），本次折讓 105 元，折讓後剩餘 <amount> (original total, already allowed in the records, this allowance, remaining). The records already have at least 2 allowances. It shows 折讓內容（應稅）： with 顧問服務：1 式 × 未稅 100 元 = 100 元，稅額 5 元, then 未稅合計 100 元, 稅額 5 元, and 折讓總額 105 元. It also states whether an allowance notice is emailed, and shows the reminder 確認送出即表示已取得買方同意。 (submitting means the buyer has agreed). The last line starts with 送出用確認碼（不屬於預覽內容）：. (3) After Turn 2, the assistant calls confirm_preview with the code. The reply starts with 折讓成功（應稅）：折讓單號 <allowance number> (Allowance issued) and shows the amounts.

positive.description: List the invoice records of the demo company. Prompt in English: List the recent invoice records of 示範公司 (the demo company).
positive.prompt: 列出示範公司最近的開立紀錄。
positive.expected_behavior: (1) The assistant calls list_invoice_records with no filter, or with a date range that covers recent days. (2) No preview or confirmation code is created. (3) The reply starts with 開立紀錄 and 共 <N> 筆 (N records in total). Up to 50 records follow, newest first. Each line has the form #<record ID> <time>｜<user email>｜<action>｜<invoice or allowance number>｜<buyer>｜<total>. The actions include 開立 (issue), 作廢 (void), and 折讓 (allowance) from the sample data and from earlier test cases. Individual buyers show as 個人. When more than 50 records match, the last line states how many records are not listed.

negative.description: Out of scope: check the receipt lottery. The user wants to know whether a uniform invoice number won the receipt lottery (統一發票對獎). Agenix Invoice issues and manages a company's own e-invoices. It does not check lottery results. Expected: the assistant does not call Agenix Invoice tools and answers in another way. Prompt in English: Check whether uniform invoice AB12345678 won the receipt lottery.
negative.prompt: 幫我對一下這張統一發票 AB12345678 有沒有中獎。

negative.description: Out of scope: write a payment reminder. The user wants a letter that asks a customer to pay. This is writing help, not issuing or managing e-invoices. Expected: the assistant writes the letter without Agenix Invoice tools. Prompt in English: Write a payment reminder letter to a customer who has not paid yet.
negative.prompt: 幫我寫一封催款信給還沒付款的客戶。

negative.description: Out of scope: make a commercial invoice template. The user wants an English commercial invoice document for an overseas customer. Agenix Invoice only issues Taiwan e-invoices through the company's own e-invoice provider account. It does not make trade documents or templates. Expected: the assistant answers without Agenix Invoice tools. Prompt in English: Make an English commercial invoice template for a US customer.
negative.prompt: 幫我做一份給美國客戶的英文商業發票（commercial invoice）範本。

zh-TW.subtitle: 跟 AI 說一聲，電子發票就開好。
zh-TW.description:
Agenix 發票小幫手讓台灣的公司在 AI 裡用對話處理電子發票：開立、預約、作廢、折讓、查詢，也能在 LINE 使用。

我們把原本繁瑣的開發票步驟，變成一句話。

ja-JP.subtitle: AIにひと言で、電子統一発票を発行
ja-JP.description:
Agenix Invoice は、台湾の企業が AI との会話で電子統一発票を扱えるツールです。発行、予約、取消、照会のほか、値引きや返品の処理もできます。AI アプリでも LINE でも使えます。

面倒だった発票の発行手順を、私たちは一言にまとめました。
